query:
*[_type == "societyEvent" && (dateTime(coalesce(endDate, date)) >= dateTime($todayStart) || (!defined(dateTime(coalesce(endDate, date))) && coalesce(endDate, date) >= $todayDate)) && hostSociety->slug.current == $slug]
    | order(date asc)[0...6]{
    _id,
    title,
    "slug": slug.current,
    date,
    endDate,
    kind,
    description,
    venue,
    location,
    isFeatured,
    "hostSociety": select(hostSociety->listed != false => hostSociety->{ _id, name, "slug": slug.current })
  }
